state.context: Users need CanDo work to track authoritative changes, accepted actions and an authored polling cadence. In the excerpt the user manually invokes refresh, WorkSources replies asynchronously and the stored response is rendered. Periodic page rendering is an authorized GET, whose language contract expressly excludes writes, remote sends and job creation. The capability is a proposed integration surface with no concrete provider. Its five business packages must author visibility-limited list/detail operations with the same completion eligibility, not rely on hidden adapter permission logic. Delegated reads require a verified user principal and team, owner-specific audience, live permission checks and expiry; the account value is only a selector and the browser bearer must stay local. Returned canonical action references retain their authenticated owner provenance, finite target registry and sealed record/version arguments. Each candidate respects these constraints and domain grants. Evaluate necessary safety and usability costs as well as authored brevity, without taking agreement as evidence of executable correctness.

freshness_owner.instructions: Choose the contract that most appropriately owns automatic source evidence updates for this SaaS language.

criteria.adapter: Add a finite watch lifecycle to WorkSources: a request provides account, locations and cadence; a response returns an opaque subscription ID, deadline, monotonic sequence and initial batch; authenticated subsequent events contain that ID, a larger sequence and a complete replacement batch. A deployment-provided adapter performs action/change-triggered and periodic owner reads with fresh delegated authorization. CanDo admits only matching unexpired sequences and withholds actions when the evidence expires or becomes unavailable. This moves recurring behavior to the existing provider, but its lease management, delegation and event-ordering contract grows.
criteria.session: Define a single library-level automatic invocation rule for the current refresh scenario, leaving WorkSources.work unchanged. During an active authorized user session it POSTs the canonical refresh after successful actions, authenticated invalidations and configured timer ticks, using current session authority and protected saved inputs. Page GET polls retain their existing read semantics. This keeps recurring service authority out of the provider while adding finite browser event/overlap rules, filter retention and draft protection, and it ceases when the session closes.
criteria.defer: Ship only the existing explicitly invoked refresh and record the unsolved automation requirement. This preserves a narrow trustworthy boundary until a protocol is decided, but users still have to request updated evidence themselves.

existing_automatic.instructions: Is the supplied explicit refresh implementation combined with representation-only polling sufficient to cause all three automatic authoritative updates?

criteria.true: The stated code and GET semantics entail refresh after actions, source changes and the configured cadence.
criteria.false: An additional trigger or owner protocol is required to establish at least one of those automatic refresh paths.
